title: Assessment of intrinsic bioremediation of jet fuel contamination in a shallow aquifer, Beaufort, South Carolina
citation: Chapelle, F.H., Landmeyer, J.E., and Bradley, P.M., 1996, Assessment of intrinsic bioremediation of jet fuel contamination in a shallow aquifer, Beaufort, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 95-4262, map scale 1:1,940.
notes: Contaminant-hydrology report. The two core logs (fig. 2, p. 10) are graphic: layer boundaries are drawn against a depth scale and cannot be read as numbers from the text, so intervals carry descriptions only, in log order, with no top/bottom. Water-chemistry tables 1-4 and model parameters were not recorded (not geologic). Monitoring-well water levels on the fig. 1 map were not legible in the text layer. Page 14 says ground water flows 'from east to west toward low-lying areas east of the site' as printed; quoted as is. All six references recorded.
